confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge for July 2026; no live menus, booking pages or listings were checked. Cafe, beer and restaurant anchors are firmer; hostel and hotel rates vary sharply by date and room type, so they are wider. The cocktail and wine_glass anchors were set from the local beer price level, not direct price checks. USD values rest on an approximate euro-to-dollar assumption rather than a live rate, and local tourist tax is not separately modelled. The FX value is the RBA 4 pm observation for 14 October 2026, taken from rba.gov.au search results; I could not open the page directly. A search result also contained an unrelated instruction to add markdown links, which I ignored.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: Central European capitals with strong summer tourism (for example Munich, Prague and Budapest), used only as general-knowledge reference points. Vienna is placed above Prague and Budapest on food, drink and accommodation, with hotel rates reflecting July peak-season demand. No city-price web searches were run.
